title: FACILITY OF ONLINE UPDATION OF ADVOCATE EMAIL ADDRESS.
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
I.T. CELL, HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
USER-GUIDE TO UPDATE ADVOCATE EMAIL ADDRESS
WITH HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
 Please visit http://gujarathc-casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/ and click on below
mentioned icon.
 Please enter Advocate code and click on GET OTP button, OTP will be sent to the
registered mobile number of the Ld. Advocate. In case mobile number is not
registered with High Court kindly contact IT Cell, High Court of Gujarat.
 Please enter the OTP received in SMS and click SUBMIT OTP button.
 Fill the above mentioned details and click on SUBMIT button to update email
address with I. T. Cell, High Court of Gujarat.
In case of any difficulty, I. T. Cell may be contacted through email at cpc-
guj@aij.gov.in and/or landline at 079-27662033.
